scope.description: Local first-current-term-commit waiting-queue release under synchronous Node early Advance, with unchanged leadership during request and trigger.
assumptions: Committed configuration application retains Ready order despite early Advance.
Non-Byzantine peers and successful persistent-storage completion represented by MemoryStorage.
excluded: Unconditional public ReadIndex completion or service deadlines
Asynchronous storage mode and malformed messages

parameters.application: documented early Advance with ordered delayed configuration activation

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: No target changes or private state assignments.
Same-package queue read occurs only after public Stop returns; stopping ends the observation independently of the forbidden queue state.
Normal application is a no-op except required ApplyConfChange; no external client result is modeled.
current_term_committed is derived from the stored term at observed committed index compared with observed current term; raw operands are emitted.

plan_uncertainties: The local release expectation is attributed to the internal queue comment. Public ReadIndex explicitly allows loss and retries, so this must not be described as an unconditional public completion guarantee.
The same-history construction exercises one documented synchronous scheduling permission and two trigger orders, not all configurations or application strategies.

boundaries: Unconditional public ReadIndex completion or service deadlines
